content: Client-side search: Fuse.js 7.4.2 (Apache-2.0) gives best typo-tolerant fuzzy matching with per-key (field-scoped) config but is slow/memory-heavy beyond a few thousand records. MiniSearch 7.2.0 (MIT) supports per-field indexing, fuzzy+prefix, boosting, field-scoped queries, fast to ~50k records. FlexSearch 0.8.x fastest for 100k+. For 'thousands' scale + per-field checkbox scoping ('smith' vs 'blacksmith'), MiniSearch is the prescriptive choice (field-scoped + fuzzy + scales), with Fuse.js as fallback for small DBs needing max typo tolerance.
